nodes.summary: Let $U_n \in \mathbb{Z}[x]$ denote the $n$-th Chebyshev polynomial of the second kind, and let $k \le n$ be natural numbers. If $n$ and $k$ have the same parity, the coefficient of $x^k$ in $U_n$ is $(-1)^{(n-k)/2} \sum_{i=0}^{k} \binom{(n+k)/2}{i} \binom{(n+k)/2 - i}{(n-k)/2}$; otherwise it is $0$.
nodes.title: Coefficients of the Chebyshev polynomials of the second kind

nodes.summary: For a commutative ring $R$ and $r, s \in R$, the polynomials $P_n \in R[x]$, $n \ge 0$, are defined by $P_0 = 1$, $P_1 = x - r$ and $P_{n+2} = (x - r) P_{n+1} - s P_n$ for every $n \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Modified Chebyshev base polynomials of the second kind

nodes.summary: For a commutative ring $R$, all $r, s, \lambda, \mu \in R$ and every $n \ge 0$, the generalized Chebyshev polynomials of the second kind $Q_n \in R[x]$ with parameters $r, s, \lambda, \mu$ satisfy $Q_{n+3} = (x - r) Q_{n+2} - s Q_{n+1}$.
nodes.title: Three-term recurrence for generalized Chebyshev polynomials

nodes.summary: For a commutative ring $R$ and $r, s, \lambda, \mu \in R$, let $P_n \in R[x]$ be the modified Chebyshev base polynomials with parameters $r, s$. The polynomials $Q_n \in R[x]$ are defined by $Q_0 = 1$, $Q_1 = P_1 - \lambda P_0$ and $Q_{n+2} = P_{n+2} - \lambda P_{n+1} - \mu P_n$ for every $n \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Generalized Chebyshev polynomials of the second kind
